title: wsutil: New API to gather compile/runtime info
description:
This new API is used in `ui/version_info.c` and by any place that calls
`ws_init_version_info()`. Current behaviour is to force the list of
present/absent dependencies into a long, unwieldy string; with this
change, dependencies are kept as a list until the time comes to format
them for output.

Lays the ground work to facilitate improving the layout of the "About"
information as mentioned at
<https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/16270#note_840035739>

Looks good! Try to keep mechanism and policy (format) changes in separate commits. Ideally the diff should be the same moving to the new API (using "with binary plugins" is acceptable).

With this MR applied, the format regarding PKCS \#11 has changed from:

```
with GnuTLS 3.6.15 and PKCS #11 support,
```

to

```
with GnuTLS 3.6.15, with PKCS#11,
```

If this is the new preferred format then related test fixture will need updating:

```
$ git grep -n 'and PKCS #11 support'
test/fixtures_ws.py:185:        have_pkcs11='and PKCS #11 support' in tshark_v,
```

It looks like the preferred format is still what's on master, for now. But the intent of this patch is to make it easier to change the format, so whenever that does happen, we'll need to keep this test fixture in mind.

There another check for "binary plugins supported" in the test suite that needs to be fixed.

```
fixtures_ws.py
187:        have_plugins='binary plugins supported' in tshark_v,
```
By that I mean fix the test suite, not the version info format.

The rest of the requested changes on this MR have been to make the output as close as possible to what it was. For consistency with this impetus, I'm going to change the version info format instead. I've filed #17960 to deal with what the new output should look like.
But now it is grammatically weird. "With binary plugins supported". Would have been better to change the test fixture IMO but I will merge this anyway.
The initial intent of this patch was to make it easier to refactor the output. Now that the ground work is out of the way, I suspect the output format won't stay like this for long.

+/** @file
+ * Declarations of routines for gathering and handling lists of
+ * present/absent features (usually actually dependencies)
+ *
+ * Wireshark - Network traffic analyzer
+ * By Gerald Combs <gerald@wireshark.org>
+ * Copyright 1998 Gerald Combs
+ *
+ * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+ */
+
+#ifndef __WSUTIL_FEATURE_LIST_H__
+#define __WSUTIL_FEATURE_LIST_H__
+
+#include <glib.h>
+#include "ws_symbol_export.h"
+
+#ifdef __cplusplus
+extern "C" {
+#endif /* __cplusplus */
+
+/*
+ * Handle to a list of features/dependencies.
+ * Semi-opaque. Functions which gather the list of features
+ * will be passed one of these to use with
+ * `with_feature()`/`without_feature()` (below).
+ */
+typedef GList **feature_list;
+
+/*
+ * The format of entries in a feature_list is a gchar* starting with a
+ * '+' or '-' character indicating if the feature is respectively
+ * present or absent, followed by the unchanged feature description.
+ * This allows the insert order of features to be preserved,
+ * while still preserving the present/absent status in a simple way.
+ */
+
+
+/*
+ * Pointer to a function which gathers a list of features.
+ */
+typedef void(*gather_feature_func)(feature_list l);
+
+/*
+ * Add an indicator to the given feature_list that the named
+ * feature is present.
+ */
+WS_DLL_PUBLIC
+void with_feature(feature_list l, const char *fmt, ...) G_GNUC_PRINTF(2,3);
+
+/*
+ * Add an indicator to the given feature_list that the named
+ * feature is absent.
+ */
+WS_DLL_PUBLIC
+void without_feature(feature_list l, const char *fmt, ...) G_GNUC_PRINTF(2,3);
+
+/*
+ * Sort the given feature list, alphabetically by feature name.
+ * (The leading '+' or '-' is not factored into the sort.)
+ * Currently unused.
+ */
+WS_DLL_PUBLIC
+void sort_features(feature_list l);
+
+/*
+ * Free the memory used by the feature list,
+ * and reset its pointer to NULL.
+ */
+WS_DLL_PUBLIC
+void free_features(feature_list l);
+
+#ifdef __cplusplus
+}
+#endif /* __cplusplus */
+
+#endif /* __WSUTIL_FEATURE_LIST_H__ */
